svg.title: Temperature, clock and process I/O traces
svg.desc: Observed samples from two separate runs. Seconds since each run first sampled. Lines connect recorded points; sampling may miss peaks. CPU and GPU clocks are reported sysfs values, not guarantees of useful compute.

g.text: Separate runs; aligned at first sample; approximately 100 ms sampling
CPU frequency (GHz); prime policy solid, six-core policy dashed
Source: raw telemetry JSONL and telemetry.csv; lines are observations, not sustained-speed claims.
